name: Cable Car
summary: A cloud sync where new phone items ride a swinging cable car up to the cloud and down to the laptop
about: Cable Car shows sync between two devices as a little ride over the hills. New notes or files on the phone get an orange dot; when they sync, paper cards fly into a red cabin that swings on its cable up to the cloud station, where a ring fills, then on down to the laptop, where the items land in its list with a tick. Auto sync is a real switch that remembers its setting; turn it off and items wait until you press Sync now.
how: Type a note and press Add note, or press Add file to put real file names on the phone.
With Auto sync on the cabin sets off by itself; switch it off to collect changes and press Sync now.
Watch the cards load, the cabin swing up to the cloud and down to the laptop, and the dots turn into ticks.
The empty cabin glides home; the lists keep the newest four items.
